<style>
:root{--bg:#f5f6fb;--surf:#fff;--ink:#16172e;--mut:#5a5d78;--line:#e0e2ee;--p:#4b3aa6;--t:#1f9e84;--g:linear-gradient(90deg,#4b3aa6,#40c9a9);--hf:'Bricolage Grotesque','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--bf:'Public Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}

.btn{display:inline-block;padding:11px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;font-size:15px}

.stats div{padding:16px 14px;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}.stats div:last-child{border:0}
.stats b{display:block;font:700 30px var(--hf)}.stats span{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:26px}
.cols h3{margin-bottom:8px}.cols ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;color:var(--mut);font-size:15px}
.proj{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.25fr;gap:30px;align-items:start}
.proj ul{padding-left:18px;margin:0 0 14px}
.shots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:26px}
.shots .full{grid-column:1/-1}
.gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:16px}
.gal figure:nth-child(1),.gal figure:nth-child(2){grid-column:span 3}
.gal figure:nth-child(n+3){grid-column:span 2}
.gal .ph{aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover}.gal figure:nth-child(-n+2) .ph{aspect-ratio:16/9}
.tl{border-left:3px solid transparent;border-image:linear-gradient(#4b3aa6,#40c9a9) 1;padding-left:22px}
.job{margin-bottom:26px}.job h3{margin-bottom:2px}.job small{color:var(--mut);display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
.job ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;color:var(--mut);font-size:15px}

footer{margin-top:56px;padding:34px 0 40px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mut)}

dialog{border:0;padding:0;background:transparent;max-width:min(96vw,1200px)}dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(8,8,20,.82)}

<section id="about"><h2>About</h2>
<p class="lead">I started as a service engineer repairing EVs and handling warranty claims, then moved into teaching the same skills. That background shapes how I train: every lesson starts from a real fault a technician will see on the shop floor.</p>
<p class="lead">At BGauss I train dealer teams on EV systems, diagnostics and repair, write the training modules and service guides, and build digital tools such as a troubleshooting dashboard with an AI technical assistant.</p></section>

<section id="skills"><h2>Skills</h2>
<p class="lead">What I teach and what I use to do it.</p>
<div class="cols">
 <div><h3>EV systems and diagnostics</h3><ul><li>EV fundamentals and powertrain</li><li>Electrical and electronic systems</li><li>Fault code analysis, root cause analysis</li><li>CAN communication and circuit analysis</li><li>Battery, motor and motor controller diagnostics</li></ul></div>
 <div><h3>Training and development</h3><ul><li>Service engineer and technician training</li><li>Dealer and field training</li><li>Training modules, presentations, manuals</li><li>Hands-on practical sessions</li><li>Technical documentation</li></ul></div>
 <div><h3>Digital and technical tools</h3><ul><li>AI-based troubleshooting solutions</li><li>HTML troubleshooting dashboard</li><li>AI expert chatbot with technical knowledge</li><li>Diagnostic tools, multimeter testing</li><li>AutoCAD, MS Office</li></ul></div>
</div></section>

<section id="project"><h2>BGauss Troubleshooting Dashboard with AI Technical Expert</h2>
<p class="lead">A single page where a service technician can look up a fault code, follow a step-by-step SOP, practise a test method or ask an AI assistant, in English, Hindi or Hinglish.</p>
<div class="proj">
 <div>
  <h3>What it does</h3>
  <ul><li>Fault code lookup for battery/BMS (E-codes), motor/MCU (P-codes) and CAN communication (U-codes), with root causes and fixes.</li>
  <li>39 troubleshooting SOPs sorted by model (C12, RUV 350/380, Oowah) and problem area.</li>
  <li>9 electrical test guides: multimeter, CAN bus, fuses, continuity, HV short, Hall sensor, relays and single line diagrams.</li>
  <li>Guided YES/NO simulations and a low-mileage audit that works out the real range from the test ride.</li>
  <li>An AI Technical Expert that asks targeted questions, ranks likely causes and points back to the dashboard entry it used.</li></ul>
  <p style="color:var(--mut);font-size:14.5px">Built with AI-assisted development. The troubleshooting content and SOP structure come from my field and training experience.</p>
 </div>
 <figure><img class="ph" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Dashboard home screen with fault code, SOP, test method and simulation entry points" data-z><figcaption>Home screen: start from a fault code, a symptom or a test method</figcaption></figure>
</div>
<div class="shots">
 <figure class="full"><img class="ph" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="AI Technical Expert answering a P0F01 fault code question on the C12" data-z><figcaption>AI Technical Expert: for a P0F01 code on the C12 it states the system involved, ranks causes and gives the first check</figcaption></figure>
 <figure><img class="ph" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Fault code list filtered by battery, motor and CAN codes" data-z><figcaption>Fault codes, filtered by system and by fault or warning</figcaption></figure>
 <figure><img class="ph" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Troubleshooting SOP cards by model and problem area" data-z><figcaption>Troubleshooting SOPs by model and problem area</figcaption></figure>
 <figure><img class="ph" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Electrical SOP guides for multimeter, CAN bus, fuse and HV checks" data-z><figcaption>Electrical guides behind every fault code and SOP</figcaption></figure>
 <figure><img class="ph" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Low mileage diagnostic simulator comparing test ride range with OEM range" data-z><figcaption>Low-mileage simulator: test-ride range against the certified range</figcaption></figure>
</div></section>
